exposure: hypoglycaemia during the oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
cohort: Women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) between 24-28 weeks of gestation who underwent an oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT).
finding: Hypoglycaemia during the oral glucose tolerance test (HdOGTT) was associated with a 25% higher risk of small-for-gestational-age (SGA) newborns after adjusting for confounders.
mod_finding: Women with hypoglycaemia during the OGTT had a lower rate of caesarean section.
